messages:
Izzy: Hey folks—thinking of a 'Board & Brews' after-work on Thu 4/22? PubRally, 7pm. Quick poll: who can come + who needs a tram pass? :board_game: :beer:
Jo: Count me in! Might be late (8pm). I can bring Ticket to Ride.
Ben: Would love to join but prefer a dry option. Will there be mocktails? :raised_hands:
Alice: PubRally has mocktails. Also can we get a table? Need to book for ~12 ppl. @Dana can you grab the booking?
Dana: Yep I can book. Which cap? 10–14? Also, tram passes—company has a commuter fund; check with @Grace.
Grace: I can cover up to 6 tram passes if needed. Will add a calendar invite once Dana confirms. :tada:
Frank: Food prefs? veg/vegan/gluten-free? I'll spin up a quick Google sheet for potluck-style snacks: http://tinyurl.com/board-brews-list
Emi: Here for games + mocktails. Prefer not to be on tabletop teams w/ heavy strategy lol :joy:
Jo: Also, can we do a mini charity dice roll? Loser buys snacks? :money_with_wings:
Izzy: Love that. Plan: Dana books for 12 at 7pm; Grace arranges tram passes for those who RSVP 'tram'; Frank makes the sheet. RSVP by EOD Mon 4/19. I'll post calendar invite and ping everyone. :sparkles:
